messages:
Luca T: hey team, quick onboarding q — where should I put runbooks and infra snippets in Notion so people can both read and edit? I want to avoid leaking creds accidentally.
Maya (DevEx): hi Luca :wave: welcome! Put operational runbooks in Docs › eng › runbooks or Docs › eng-infra › runbooks depending on which team owns the service. For snippets that contain secrets, keep only non-secret snippets in Notion and reference the vault path (HashiCorp/Docs) instead.
Luca T: thanks. For the runbook template, i used the 'Incident Runbook' template but it's in the SRE space. Can I copy it into eng-infra and then grant edit access to the infra team?
Rina: you can duplicate and move it as long as you have duplicate rights on the original page. If the original is in a different team's private space you may see "You don't have permission to duplicate".
Luca T: that's what I'm seeing — duplication blocked. error: "You need permission to duplicate this page".
Maya (DevEx): ok, two options: 1) We can request a transfer/dup via Docs Ops (keeps page history). 2) If you just need the template without metadata, someone on SRE can duplicate it and drop it in eng-infra and then we add it to Templates. Which do you prefer?
Luca T: prefer transfer so authorship and comments remain.
Maya (DevEx): filed DOC-901: "Transfer Incident Runbook template -> eng-infra"). Docs Ops will handle ownership and permissions. Docs Ops Bot should post the ticket link.
Docs Ops Bot: Ticket DOC-901 created: Transfer request for page "Incident Runbook". Assignee: Docs Ops. https://tickets.redwood.com/DOC-901
Ana: tagging SRE owners: @sre-oncall please confirm you're okay with transfer. Also once it's in eng-infra we'll add it to Templates › Runbooks and set group perms to infra@redwood.com as Can edit.
Rina: FYI when you move pages into a team space, set the page property "Visibility" to Team so it appears in the space nav. Also follow naming: <service>-runbook (lowercase) — we added that to Templates guide.
Luca T: awesome. one more: if i create a private page and later want to make it team-editable, is there a preferred flow?
Maya (DevEx): create in your private space, add a "Migration" tag in page properties, then open Share -> Invite eng-infra group as Can edit and create a Docs Ops ticket if moving across owners. That helps us track who requested migration.
Luca T: moved and checked — I can see the duplicate now. big thanks!
Ana: I reviewed and updated the template with a short terraform snippet placeholder and a warning to never paste secrets. Added link to vault docs.
Luca T: perfect. closing loop: where's the canonical templates index?
Maya (DevEx): Templates index is Docs › Templates › Team templates. If you want a template added, open a PR in the templates tracker (link at top of the Templates page) or ping #devex with the page link and reason.
Luca T: saved, thanks everyone :clap:
Maya (DevEx): welcome! if anything else blocks onboarding ping me directly.
